title: Independent Research in Sociology
description:
Prerequisite: SOCY202, with a C or better in the course.
Restriction: SOCY Majors and Minors only; By permission only. Students will design a research project and execute it under the supervision of the course instructor. The course targets advanced undergraduates who have research projects that they would like to develop further. Students will meet regularly as a group to discuss their research topic and receive feedback. Students must submit a research prospectus for approval from the course instructor before they may enroll in the course. Contact the Undergraduate Office for more information. Fulfills a SOCY4XX Research credit.
